statBlock.name: Anarch
statBlock.classification: Small or Medium humanoid (any race), chaotic neutral
statBlock.description: A Gruul raider who rushes enemies and knocks down anything built in the way.

sections.Traits: Siege Monster. The anarch deals double damage to objects and structures.
sections.Bonus actions: Aggressive. Move up to the anarch’s speed toward a hostile creature it can see.
sections.Actions: Spiked Club. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage when wielded with two hands.

statBlock.name: Archon of the Triumvirate
statBlock.description: An armored embodiment of strict law, often riding a winged felidar over the Azorius guildhall.

sections.Damage resistances: Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Immortal Nature. The archon needs no food, drink, or sleep.
Mount. While the archon is mounted and not incapacitated, it cannot be surprised. It and its mount have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. If the mounted archon reaches 0 HP, its mount also drops to 0 HP.
sections.Innate Spellcasting:
Wisdom is the spellcasting ability (save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). No material components are required.
At will. Calm Emotions, Command, Compelled Duel.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Hammer of Justice attacks.
Hammer of Justice. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (2d6 + 5) bludgeoning and 18 (4d8) force damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 18 Strength save or fall prone.
Pacifying Presence. Choose any number of creatures the archon can see within 120 ft. On a failed DC 18 Wisdom save, a target drops held weapons, loses concentration, and becomes charmed by the archon for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect. A creature that succeeds on the save or recovers from the effect is immune to this archon’s Pacifying Presence for 24 hours.
sections.Bonus actions:
Eye of the Law. Choose a visible creature within 120 ft. to learn which laws it broke in the past 24 hours.
Mount. While unmounted, the archon can magically teleport with all worn and carried equipment into the saddle of its mount if both are on the same plane.
sections.Legendary actions:
The archon has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of its turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Rejoin Mount (1 action). If unmounted, magically teleport onto its mount and mount it, provided both are on the same plane.
Smite (2 actions). Make a Hammer of Justice attack. Its mount can then spend its reaction to make a melee weapon attack.
Detention (3 actions). Choose a visible creature within 60 ft. On a failed DC 18 Charisma save, the target is magically sent to a harmless demiplane. At the end of the archon’s next turn, it reappears where it left or in the nearest unoccupied space.
sections.Mount stat block: Use Felidar for the usual mount and add a fly speed of 40 ft. as described in the Winged Felidars sidebar.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 192. Winged Felidars on p. 199.

statBlock.name: Arclight Phoenix
statBlock.description: A bird of living lightning. Its death leaves a warm mizzium egg that can hatch when fed magic.

sections.Damage resistances: Thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Elemental Nature. The phoenix needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Grounded Lightning. The first time it touches the ground on any turn, the phoenix takes 11 (2d10) force damage.
Illumination. It sheds bright light for 15 ft. and dim light for another 15 ft.
Lightning Form. The phoenix fits through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. A creature that touches it or hits it in melee from within 5 ft. takes 9 (2d8) lightning damage. The phoenix can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. The first time the phoenix enters any given creature’s space on a turn, that creature takes the same lightning damage.
Crackling Death. When the phoenix dies, each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 18 Dexterity save, taking 36 (8d8) lightning damage on a failure or half on a success. Only a warm Tiny egg with a mizzium shell remains. A spell that deals lightning damage hatches it if the egg is in the spell’s area. A creature touching the egg can also hatch it by spending spell slots totaling at least 13 levels. The new phoenix appears in the egg’s space.
sections.Actions: Arclight Touch. Melee weapon attack, +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 27 (6d8) lightning damage. Lightning then jumps to a second creature of the phoenix’s choice that it can see within 30 ft. of the first target. The second creature takes 27 (6d8) lightning damage on a failed DC 18 Dexterity save.

statBlock.name: Aurelia
statBlock.description: The Boros guildmaster leads from the front, sending allies into the fight and turning a strike into battlefield healing.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic and radiant. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Immortal Nature. As a Ravnican angel, Aurelia needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). Aurelia can turn a failed save into a success.
Magic Resistance. Aurelia has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Longsword attacks and use Leadership.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +15 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 12 (1d8 + 8) slashing or 13 (1d10 + 8) slashing with two hands, plus 27 (6d8) radiant damage either way.
Leadership. Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. If it can hear Aurelia, it can add 1d10 to one attack roll or saving throw before the start of Aurelia’s next turn.
Warleader’s Helix (Recharge 5–6). Ranged spell attack, +17 to hit, range 60 ft., one creature. A hit deals 54 (12d8) radiant damage. Aurelia can also choose a different creature she can see within 10 ft. of the target to regain 27 (6d8) HP.
sections.Reactions:
Parry. Add 7 to AC against a melee attack that would hit Aurelia. She must see the attacker and wield a melee weapon.
Unyielding. When an effect would move Aurelia, knock her prone, or both, she can prevent both outcomes.
sections.Legendary actions:
Aurelia has three legendary actions and regains spent actions at the start of her turn. Use one option at a time at the end of another creature’s turn.
Command Allies (1 action). Choose up to three creatures Aurelia can see within 30 ft. Each chosen creature that can see or hear her can immediately spend its reaction on one weapon attack with advantage.
Longsword Attack (2 actions). Make one Longsword attack.
Frighten Foes (3 actions). Choose up to five visible creatures within 30 ft. Each must pass a DC 25 Wisdom save or become frightened of Aurelia until the end of her next turn. Targets within 5 ft. of her have disadvantage on the save.
sections.Printed source: Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica, p. 230. Ravnican angel traits on p. 189.

statBlock.name: Battleforce Angel
statBlock.description: A Boros officer who dives into battle and rallies nearby troops.

sections.Traits:
Immortal Nature. The angel needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Flyby. Flying out of an enemy’s reach does not provoke an opportunity attack.
Magic Resistance. The angel has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two melee attacks and use Battlefield Inspiration.
Longsword. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) slashing or 8 (1d10 + 3) slashing with two hands, plus 18 (4d8) radiant damage either way. A target within 5 ft. of one or more of the angel’s allies takes another 2 (1d4) radiant damage.
Battlefield Inspiration. Choose up to three visible creatures within 30 ft. They can add 1d4 to their attack rolls and saving throws until the end of the angel’s next turn.

statBlock.name: Biomancer
statBlock.description: A Simic wizard whose life magic sustains allies while the fight continues around them.

sections.Traits:
Bolstering Presence. An ally that starts its turn within 30 ft. of the biomancer regains 5 (1d10) HP from the biomancer’s magic.
Magic Resistance. The biomancer has advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
sections.Spellcasting:
The biomancer is a 16th-level Simic spellcaster with wizard spells prepared. Intelligence is the spellcasting ability (save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks).
Cantrips (at will). Acid Splash, Light, Mending, Poison Spray, Shocking Grasp.
1st level (4 slots). Detect Magic, Grease, Shield.
2nd level (3 slots). Alter Self, Darkvision, Enlarge/Reduce, Hold Person.
3rd level (3 slots). Counterspell, Dispel Magic, Haste, Protection from Energy.
4th level (3 slots). Confusion, Conjure Minor Elementals, Polymorph.
5th level (2 slots). Cone of Cold, Creation, Hold Monster.
6th level (1 slot). Move Earth, Wall of Ice.
7th level (1 slot). Prismatic Spray.
8th level (1 slot). Control Weather.
sections.Actions: Scimitar. Melee weapon attack, +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

statBlock.name: Blistercoil Weird
statBlock.description: An Izzet mixture of water and molten rock. Magical fire feeds its growth until the accumulated energy bursts free.

sections.Damage resistances: Cold and fire. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Exhaustion, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained, unconscious.
sections.Traits:
Elemental Nature. The weird needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
Feed on Fire. Fire damage from a spell or another magical effect increases the weird’s size by one category, limited by available space. At Large or bigger, it has advantage on Strength checks and saves. If it starts its turn Gargantuan, it explodes and returns to Medium. Each creature within 30 ft. makes a DC 12 Dexterity save, taking 28 (8d6) fire damage on a failure or half on a success. The explosion ignites flammable objects that nobody wears or carries.
Form of Fire and Water. The weird can pass through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. It can enter a hostile creature’s space and stop there. The first time the weird enters any given creature’s space on a turn, the creature takes 5 (1d10) fire damage and ignites. It takes another 5 (1d10) fire damage at the start of each of its turns until someone uses an action to douse the fire.
Heated Body. A creature that touches the weird or hits it in melee from within 5 ft. takes 5 (1d10) fire damage.
Illumination. It sheds bright light for 30 ft. and dim light for another 30 ft.
sections.Actions: Slam. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) fire damage. If the weird is Large or bigger, use 11 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning plus 14 (4d6) fire damage instead.
